# netskope Provider

Netskope Terraform Provider: Combined specification to produce netskope terraform provider via speakeasy

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    netskope = {
      source  = "netskopeoss/netskope"
      version = "0.3.20"
    }
  }
}

provider "netskope" {
  server_url = "..." # Optional - can use NETSKOPE_SERVER_URL environment variable
  tenant     = "..." # Optional
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API Key. Configurable via environment variable `NETSKOPE_API_KEY`.
- `server_url` (String) Server URL (defaults to https://{tenant}.goskope.com/api/v2)
- `tenant` (String) this value is assigned by Netskope, in this example `demo.goskope.com` (defaults to demo)
